div.div: حَفٍ , applied to a man, (S, Mgh, Msb, K,) and a camel, (K,) and a horse or the like, (Zj, S, K, Ham p. 476,) Having his foot, (S, Mgh, Msb, K,) or hoof, (Zj, S, K, Ham,) attenuated [in the sole], (Zj, S, Mgh, Msb, K,) or chafed, abraded, or worn, (Ham, PS,) by much walking or treading or travel; (S, Mgh, Msb, Ham;) as also ↓ حَافٍ . (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
